title: BlackRock Dodges AI Bond Flop as $12.3 Billion Debt Deal Rallies

title: Intel’s Capex Plans Offer a Quiet Positive for the Foundry Business. The Real Test Is Still Execution.
title_zh: 英特尔的资本支出计划为代工业务带来了悄然的积极影响。真正的考验仍然是执行。
summary: Intel said 2026 capital expenditures will rise above $20 billion, with 2027 spending expected to be even higher, as the company invests to address tight capacity and AI-driven demand in its foundry business.
summary_zh: 英特尔表示，2026 年的资本支出将超过 200 亿美元，2027 年的支出预计会更高，因为该公司将进行投资以解决其代工业务的产能紧张和人工智能驱动的需求。

title: KKR, Blackstone Sign $16 Billion Kuwait Oil Deal
title_zh: KKR 与 Blackstone 签署 160 亿美元科威特石油交易
summary: The companies that manage Kuwait’s oil sector signed a $16 billion lease agreement with a group of investors led by Blackstone, Brookfield and KKR.
summary_zh: 管理科威特石油行业的公司与以 Blackstone、Brookfield 和 KKR 为首的投资者集团签署了价值 160 亿美元的租赁协议。
